chapter: Later years and the Texas scene
title: Southern Melody Boys and other San Antonio bands
summary: Albert explains Millard McNeil's Southern Melody Boys and A.J. Johnson's Southern Centipeders as the same group.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did the Desdems ever get down there? Dan Desdems or Clarence Desdems? Did you ever meet them?
Clarence Desdems from here? No. Dan, you never did meet up with them? No.
There was a band called the Southern Serenagers. Did you ever hear of them?

The Southern Melody Boys or the Southern Centipaders? It could have been any name. Both of them. There were two. Southern Melody Boys and the Southern Centipaders. And who were they? Millard McNeil. And he had the Southern Melody Boys. A.J. Johnson went into the Southern Centipaders. And it was the same person. I'll just change the names there.
And where were they from? San Antonio. I see. I think that's the band that made a record with them. They just didn't know anything about them.
Well, maybe they might have had Boots and his Buddies. See, all that's the same thing.
